problem: After partial-failure classification was added, an all-success export now reports failure, so deployment automation stops batches that completed successfully.
outcome: An export in which every record succeeds again reports success exactly as it did before partial-failure classification changed.
acceptance: An all-success export reports the same success result that operators received before the partial-failure change
Deployment automation continues an all-success batch exactly as before
Partial-failure results and retry behavior remain unchanged
non_goals: Changing the existing partial-failure result or retry behavior
Adding output, events, notifications, state changes, or actions for all-success exports beyond the existing success result and deployment continuation
